column1: # Phase 1 walking skeleton: one model, one substrate, one cue family, all arms.
# Qwen3-8B rather than Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct because the Llama gated licence is still
# pending (PERMISSIONS.md); Qwen3-8B is ungated. enable_thinking off via the chat
# template so the frozen num_predict=320 is a fair budget.
# Card: a100-40, not a100-80. The live QOS caps a100-80 at 4 (not the 8 CONTRACT.md
# assumes) and another campaign holds all 4, so an a100-80 request only pends. Qwen3-8B
# in bf16 is about 16 GB and fits a 40 GB card with room to spare, and a100-40 is the
# same Ampere generation as a100-80, so the measured rate transfers to the sweep's
# a100-80 serving line far better than a Hopper card would.
